outputs.explanation: Panel A shows bright-field and fluorescence macroscopic photographs of whole lungs (photograph/gross imaging), not a plot of averaged data.
Bar chart of mean ICG fluorescence intensity with individual mouse data points (blue and red dots) overlaid on each bar, alongside the mean ± SD.
Panel contains H&E/ICG/RNAscope micrographs plus spatial transcriptomics heatmap-style plots (Cd68, Spp1 expression per spot). Spatial heatmaps do not require individual data point overlays.
GSEA enrichment plots are line plots; overlaying individual points is not applicable/would make them unreadable, so they are exempt from this check.

Bar graph shows log2 fold-change values per gene derived from differential expression analysis (Seurat FindMarkers, Wilcoxon test across thousands of spatial spots), with associated p-values. Each bar represents a single computed statistic per gene rather than a mean of a small number of discrete replicates, so individual data point overlay is not applicable here.
Panel F shows representative fluorescence images and IHC micrographs, not a plot of averaged/aggregated quantitative data.
